examples.en: Will your preschooler need a tutor?
examples.zh: 你的学龄前孩子需要家教吗？

examples.en: The average preschooler sees about three ads a day, according to the findings. Teenagers see about five per day.
examples.zh: 根据该研究的发现，学前儿童平均一日看到大约3则广告，十多岁儿童看到大约5则。

examples.en: As a parent you might never guess all the ways a good imagination benefits your child. It helps a preschooler.
examples.zh: 父母可能永远无法意识到好的想象力对于孩子能有多大的帮助。
